name: Pre-1: Acme Analytics spec sourcing (park)
providerBrief: Acme Analytics is a usage-analytics platform. Its public API exposes a whoami endpoint (GET /v1/me) and business endpoints (projects, reports, invoices). User and group management is available only in the Acme web console - there is no public API for member listing, roles, or key inventory. Source the spec and run the IAM go/no-go gate.

expectedParkEvidence.vendor_doc: User and group management is available only in the Acme web console; there is no public API for member listing, role management, or API key inventory.
expectedParkEvidence.revisit_trigger: Acme ships a members or teams API (e.g. GET /v1/users or GET /v1/teams/{id}/members)
